en.title: Jev moderation, stance and sentiment evaluation
en.description: Read language-task results through policy labels, retrieval conditions, conversational context, extra inference and supervised postprocessing.
en.answer: A strong language-task benchmark score does not by itself establish policy adherence or transfer to another language. Compare annotation rules, input context, candidate menus, supervision and inference budgets before reusing the result.
en.scope: Five fixed-version abstracts, selected methods/results/limitations and one implementation README were inspected. Findings remain author-reported; no prediction records or experiments were reproduced.

sections.title: Policy adherence or label agreement?
sections.text: HATEDECIDE finds that supplying definitions and decomposing a moderation decision do not reliably improve agreement with existing dataset labels. A prediction can follow the supplied definition yet disagree with the original annotation policy. Component answers make the aggregation rule inspectable, but they are not verified explanations without component-level reference labels. Evaluate the actual policy and both false-positive and false-negative costs; English diagnostic examples do not establish everyday or multilingual moderation performance.

sections.title: What information does retrieval add?
sections.text: The online-moderation study separates written rules, labeled precedents and restrictions on the answer menu. Its main policy contrast adds precedents while keeping the complete menu fixed. For OLID and HateXplain, however, precedents come from the cleaned evaluation population with the target excluded; this differs from using only a frozen training collection. Media inputs are generated textual captions, not a test of native Jev vision. Report these information sources and candidate restrictions alongside the score.

sections.title: What changes across languages?
sections.text: The stance study compares English text–target pairs with Chinese speaker-tagged conversations. Language, dataset and conversational structure therefore change together. Jev has more difficulty with support/opposition in the conversational benchmark, but this does not isolate a language effect or prove an internal mechanism. Some LLMs also receive batches while Jev receives single records. Our suggested transfer test holds task structure and information access fixed and checks target-language annotation definitions independently.

sections.title: Do more questions improve the result?
sections.text: Emo-Jev compares direct classification with atomic-question composition and multiple predefined judgment paths. Both extensions have lower average macro-F1 than direct Jev in the reported eight-dataset setup, with task-specific gains and losses. Extra paths add dependent stages and cost; some retry usage is missing. HATEDECIDE likewise finds no consistent benefit from decomposition. Compare the direct baseline, the full added-question budget and held-out outcomes rather than assuming that more intermediate answers provide better reasoning or calibrated probabilities.

sections.title: What does a frozen backbone still learn?
sections.text: The DimABSA system uses frozen Jev with 488 coefficients fitted to task labels for regression and extraction. Its strong regression aggregate relies on supervised calibration; the competition ranks individual corpora, not the reconstructed pooled aggregate. Development scoring does not nest the full feature/threshold selection process, and some text overlap remains. The public code includes fitted parameters and metric summaries, while text-bearing prediction caches are withheld. Separate backbone tuning, supervised postprocessing, selection and artifact availability when comparing results.

zh.title: Jev 审核、立场与情感任务评测
zh.description: 从规则标签、检索条件、对话上下文、额外推理与监督后处理理解语言任务结果。
zh.answer: 语言任务基准分数较强，本身不证明遵循新规则或迁移到另一语言。复用结果前，应比较标注规则、输入上下文、候选菜单、监督信息和推理预算。
zh.scope: 已核查五篇固定版本摘要、指定方法／结果／局限段落，以及一个实现说明。结论仍为作者报告，未复现预测记录或实验。

sections.title: 遵循规则，还是符合原有标签？
sections.text: HATEDECIDE 发现，提供定义或分解审核决策，并不稳定提高与已有标签的一致率。预测可能遵循所给定义，却与原始标注规则冲突。组件答案让聚合规则可检查，但没有组件级参考标签就不是已核实的解释。应评估实际规则以及误报、漏报的代价；英语诊断样本不能证明日常或多语言审核表现。

sections.title: 检索究竟增加了什么信息？
sections.text: 在线审核研究区分书面规则、带标签先例和候选菜单限制；其主要规则对照保持完整菜单，仅加入先例。不过，OLID 与 HateXplain 的先例来自清洗后的评测总体，只排除当前目标，这不同于只使用冻结训练集合。媒体输入是生成的文字描述，不是原生 Jev 视觉能力测试。分数旁应同时报告这些信息来源和候选限制。

sections.title: 跨语言比较还改变了什么？
sections.text: 立场研究比较英语文本—目标对与带说话人标签的中文对话，因此语言、数据集和对话结构同时改变。Jev 在对话基准中更难区分支持与反对，但这没有单独识别语言效应，也不证明内部机制。一些语言模型还使用批请求，而 Jev 使用单条请求。我们建议迁移测试固定任务结构与信息访问，并独立检查目标语言的标注定义。

sections.title: 问题更多，结果就更好吗？
sections.text: Emo-Jev 将直接分类与原子问题组合、多条预定义判断路径比较。在所报八个数据集上，两种扩展的平均宏 F1 都低于直接 Jev，各任务有增有减。额外路径增加依赖阶段与成本，部分重试用量还未计入。HATEDECIDE 同样未发现分解的稳定收益。应比较直接基线、全部新增问题预算与留出结果，不能默认更多中间答案代表更好的推理或已校准概率。

sections.title: 冻结骨干后，系统仍然学了什么？
sections.text: DimABSA 用冻结的 Jev 和 488 个由任务标签拟合的系数完成回归与抽取。较强的回归汇总表现依赖监督校准；比赛按各语料排名，而非重建的合并汇总。开发集评分没有嵌套完整的特征／阈值选择流程，部分文本重叠仍在。公开代码包含拟合参数和指标汇总，但未分发含原文的预测缓存。比较时应区分骨干微调、监督后处理、选择流程和材料可用性。

en.title: Jev calibration, abstention and confidence routing
en.description: Compare probability quality, missing-answer rejection, threshold transfer and cascade cost using six versioned studies and explicit evaluation controls.
en.answer: Better-calibrated probabilities do not guarantee a reliable abstention gate or a cheaper cascade. Evaluate the whole policy on held-out target data, separate missing-answer populations, and compare confidence routing with random escalation at the same budget.
en.scope: Six fixed-version abstracts, selected manuscript sections and release documentation were inspected. Findings remain author-reported; no model experiment, prediction replay or proof verification was performed.

sections.title: Which quantity should improve?
sections.text: Probability accuracy, interface coherence, accepted-case error and decision cost answer different questions. Probability Contracts uses worlds with known posteriors to separate them: averaging two reports can improve expected Brier score without improving a decision at every deferral cost. Its guarantee compares averaging with random interface selection, not with each interface individually. Report validity and coverage too; an interface that produces no usable probabilities has undefined probability accuracy.

sections.title: Why is the correct answer missing?
sections.text: An artificially removed answer, a retrieval miss and an out-of-scope query are different populations. The candidate-coverage benchmark reports them separately; at ten retrieval candidates, its natural-miss result has only five supporting queries. The arithmetic rejection study adds another distinction: selecting None in a menu differs from verifying each candidate with a Boolean question. Thresholds tuned on separate development problems improve its tested rejection tradeoff, but do not establish a universal threshold.

sources.label: Arithmetic rejection and threshold rules, v1

sections.title: Will a threshold survive a new task?
sections.text: A source-task calibration constraint is not a target-task risk guarantee. The coverage study holds calibration budgets equal and finds that transferred thresholds can over-reject covered inputs or stop detecting missing answers. The Laya reproduction separately finds that a better probability metric does not ensure the frozen gate meets its held-out error target. Its labels come from a synthetic teacher, and its initial reproduction is retrospective. Compare source-frozen and target-recalibrated policies on disjoint target data, with label budgets stated.

sections.title: Does confidence improve routing?
sections.text: A cascade should be compared with the cheap model alone, the fallback alone, and random escalation at a matched budget. In the 495-claim RAG study, similar aggregate scores conceal different false-verification rates. One threshold is cross-fitted, while its matched-random control uses in-sample operating points; neither nonsignificance nor that control establishes equivalence. Our proposed stronger comparison freezes the entire routing procedure and random-control budget before testing on new claims.

sections.title: What belongs in total cost?
sections.text: Count the first-stage decision for every item, then all escalated calls, retries and routing overhead. Report cost per attempted input, coverage and end-to-end quality together. Fast Models, Slow Evidence corrected omitted pre-screen cost, confusion between gate accuracy and final quality, and in-sample threshold optimism. The RAG cascade is an offline replay whose price calculation excludes second-hop overhead, retries and queueing; it has no controlled latency result. These studies do not establish current prices or universal production savings.

sections.title: What do the artifacts support?
sections.text: The candidate-coverage repository separates recorded-output scoring from source-text reconstruction and fresh inference. sys1-eval documents raw-response reanalysis; the RAG repository requires upstream access to the gold labels. Laya’s ancillary inventory lists predictions, metric code and manifests, but also withheld collection/training source. A listed file or publisher checksum is not an independently reproduced result. We inspected the documentation and inventories, without running these procedures or auditing their prediction records.

zh.title: Jev 校准、拒答与置信度路由
zh.description: 结合六篇固定版本研究，比较概率质量、缺失答案拒答、阈值迁移和级联成本，并明确评测对照。
zh.answer: 概率校准更好，不保证拒答门控可靠或级联更便宜。应在留出的目标数据上评估完整策略，区分答案缺失的不同来源，并将置信度路由与同预算随机升级比较。
zh.scope: 已核查六篇固定版本摘要、指定正文段落及发布说明；结论仍为作者报告，未运行模型实验、回放预测或验证证明。

sections.title: 到底要改善哪一个量？
sections.text: 概率准确性、接口一致性、接纳样本错误率和决策成本回答不同问题。Probability Contracts 用已知后验的有限世界将它们分开：平均两份概率报告可改善期望 Brier 分数，却不保证每个转交成本下的决策更好。该保证的对照是随机选择接口，而非每个单独接口。还应报告输出有效性与覆盖率；无法输出可用概率的接口，其概率准确性没有定义。

sections.title: 正确答案为什么不在候选里？
sections.text: 人为移除答案、检索遗漏与范围外查询属于不同总体。候选覆盖基准分别报告它们；当检索候选数为十时，自然遗漏结果仅由五条查询支持。算术拒答研究还区分了菜单中选择 None 与逐候选布尔核验。使用独立开发问题调节阈值，改善了所测拒答取舍，但没有确立通用阈值。

sources.label: 算术拒答与阈值规则 v1

sections.title: 阈值换一个任务还能用吗？
sections.text: 源任务上的校准约束不是目标任务的风险保证。候选覆盖研究固定校准预算，发现迁移阈值可能大量误拒已有答案的输入，或不再检出缺失答案。Laya 复现则显示，概率指标改善不保证冻结门控达到留出集错误率目标；其标签来自合成教师，初始复现属于回顾性分析。我们建议在独立目标数据上比较沿用源阈值与重新校准的策略，并明确标签预算。

sections.title: 置信度是否优于同预算的随机升级？
sections.text: 级联应同时对照仅用便宜模型、仅用后备模型，以及相同预算的随机升级。495 条声明的 RAG 研究显示，汇总分数相近仍可有不同误放率。一个阈值经过交叉拟合，但同预算随机对照使用样本内选择的工作点；不显著差异及该对照都不能证明等效性。我们建议更强的比较：在测试新声明前，冻结完整路由流程和随机对照预算。

sections.title: 总成本的分母和分子应包含什么？
sections.text: 每条输入都要计入第一阶段判断，再加上所有升级调用、重试与路由开销；应同时报告每次尝试输入的成本、覆盖率与端到端质量。Fast Models, Slow Evidence 修正了遗漏前置筛查成本、混淆门控准确率与最终质量，以及样本内阈值过于乐观的问题。RAG 级联只是离线回放，其计价不含第二跳开销、重试和排队，也没有受控时延结果。这些研究不能确立当前价格或普遍生产节省。

sources.label: 自查 agent 评测 v1

sections.title: 公开材料能支持哪一步核查？
sections.text: 候选覆盖仓库将已记录输出评分、源文本重建和重新推理分开。sys1-eval 说明了原始响应重分析方法；RAG 仓库的参考标签需取得上游访问权限。Laya 附属目录列出预测、指标代码和运行记录，同时明确部分采集／训练源码未公开。文件列出或发布者提供哈希，不等于独立复现结果。本项目只检查说明和目录，未执行这些流程或审计逐项预测。

en.title: Option-label bias in Jev-style decision models
en.description: Separate option-label bias from order sensitivity using versioned research, conditional invariance claims and a practical diagnostic.
en.answer: A valid typed answer can follow an option’s familiar name instead of its assigned definition. The observed failure and its cause are separate questions: evidence from inspected open implementations should not be treated as an explanation of hosted Jev’s internals.
en.scope: Independent research note based on versioned abstracts and the collection’s scoped reviews. Findings are author-reported; no attack or model experiment was run here.

sections.title: Which studies answer which question?
sections.text: Sun and colleagues test conflicts between option names and definitions. Azizi and colleagues’ Labels Override Definitions examines how open implementations render those fields, including interventions that hold weights fixed. Their later One Word Opens the Gate evaluates attacker-controlled option channels in guardrail settings. These are distinct papers with different experimental questions; sharing a failure theme does not make their results interchangeable.

sources.label: One Word Opens the Gate, v1

sections.title: Why inspect the rendered request?
sections.text: The fixed-weight rendering intervention in Labels Override Definitions provides evidence about the tested interface implementation. That is a narrower claim than saying every constrained decision head has the same defect. Before comparing systems, identify whether the option key, label and definition all reach the model, and whether the adapter rewrites or drops any of them.

sections.title: Does order stability fix label bias?
sections.text: Runoff scores options individually before comparing balanced finalist listings. Its order-invariance argument assumes deterministic responses and a unique canonical ranking; the paper explicitly leaves option-name bias outside its target. Verdict-MQ describes architectural order/grouping invariance when retained state tokens are identical after truncation. These are conditional claims about changing a request’s arrangement, not proof of semantic correctness, calibrated confidence or resistance to malicious option names.

sections.title: What changes when an option is added?
sections.text: Prism-1 isolates option readouts to preserve order invariance and relative odds among original options when the candidate set changes, with state and question held fixed. This does not keep every normalized probability unchanged: an added score changes the softmax denominator. Its paper requires fine-tuning and limits the guarantee to numerical precision; independently judged options fit better than menu-dependent rules such as none of the above. Injected text in the shared state remains outside this protection. Evaluate menu-dependent fallback behavior separately, using the paired-rule tests rather than treating stable rankings as correct abstention.

sections.title: A diagnostic to use in your own evaluation
sections.text: Our suggested comparison fixes the state, task rule, model version and scoring rule. Prepare equivalent requests with informative labels, neutral identifiers and definition-only options where the interface permits them. Add a separate conflicting-label condition, with expected answers checked before querying. Compare answer changes, errors and confidence on errors; preserve the actual rendered inputs. Use a held-out set to test any proposed repair. Test option permutations and identical-request repeats separately from label changes. Match the retained input after truncation when testing an invariance claim.

sections.title: What would remain unproven?
sections.text: An adapter fix on one open implementation is not a universal injection defense. The guardrail study concerns open-weight models and does not demonstrate a compromise of hosted Jev. Keep the attacker’s permitted input channels explicit, and distinguish a changed distribution, a wrong choice and a downstream action. The diagnostic above is a proposed protocol, not a reproduced finding.

zh.title: Jev 类决策模型的选项标签偏置
zh.description: 区分选项标签偏置与顺序敏感性，结合固定版本研究、带条件的不变性主张和可操作的诊断。
zh.answer: 格式有效的类型化答案，仍可能遵循选项名称的常见含义，而非为它指定的定义。观察到的错误与错误成因是两个问题；开放实现中的证据不能直接解释托管 Jev 的内部机制。
zh.scope: 依据固定版本摘要和本项目已有专项核查整理的独立研究笔记。结论由作者报告，本项目未运行攻击或模型实验。

sections.title: 三篇研究分别回答什么？
sections.text: Sun 等研究选项名称与定义冲突时的行为。Azizi 等的 Labels Override Definitions 检查开放实现如何渲染这些字段，包括固定权重的干预。他们后来的 One Word Opens the Gate 则在防护场景中评估由攻击者控制的选项通道。这是实验问题不同的三篇论文；讨论相近失效现象，不意味着结果可以互换。

sources.label: One Word Opens the Gate v1

sections.title: 为什么要检查实际渲染请求？
sections.text: Labels Override Definitions 的固定权重渲染干预，为所测接口实现提供了机制证据。它比“所有受约束决策头都有同样缺陷”的主张窄得多。比较系统前，先确认选项键、标签和定义是否都进入模型，以及适配层是否改写或遗漏了字段。

sections.title: 顺序稳定能修复标签偏置吗？
sections.text: Runoff 先逐个评分选项，再比较位置平衡的入围列表。其顺序不变性论证假设响应确定、规范排序唯一，论文明确不处理选项名称偏置。Verdict-MQ 则描述在截断后保留状态 token 一致时，架构对选项顺序和问题分组的不变性。这些主张都带有条件，涉及请求排列变化，不证明语义正确、置信度校准或对恶意选项名称的防御。

sources.label: Runoff 的限制与假设 v1

sections.title: 增加一个选项时，哪些量会变化？
sections.text: Prism-1 隔离选项读出，在固定状态和问题时，保持候选变化下的顺序不变性以及原有选项间的概率比。每个归一化概率并不因此保持不变：新增分数会改变 softmax 分母。论文说明它需要微调，保证受数值精度限制，更适合可独立判断的选项，而非“以上皆非”等依赖整个候选集的规则；共享状态中的注入文本也不在保护范围内。应单独用成对规则测试检查此类兜底行为，不把排序稳定当作正确拒答。

sections.title: 怎样设计自己的诊断？
sections.text: 我们建议固定状态、任务规则、模型版本和评分方式，准备有含义标签、中性编号，以及接口允许时只含定义的等价请求。另设标签与定义冲突的条件，在调用前核对预期答案。比较答案变化、错误及错误时的置信度，并保存实际渲染输入。任何修复都应在留出样本上重新测试。把选项排列变化、相同请求重复测试和标签变化分开；检验不变性主张时，还需对齐截断后保留的输入。

sections.title: 哪些结论仍不能成立？
sections.text: 一个开放实现中的适配层修复不等于通用注入防御。防护论文测试开放权重模型，未证明托管 Jev 已被攻破。应明确攻击者能控制哪些输入通道，并区分分布变化、错误选择与下游动作。上述诊断是建议流程，不是本项目复现的发现。

en.title: AudioJev: audio decisions, order calibration and release limits
en.description: Read AudioJev’s paper, checkpoint and inference library together: candidate-order stability, seed-specific results, data overlap and separate licenses.
en.answer: AudioJev is an independent audio decision model that scores supplied alternatives from a waveform and question. Its order-calibration objective addresses sensitivity to candidate order; it does not establish that a returned probability equals the empirical chance of being correct.
en.scope: Based on the fixed-v1 abstract, public model card and inference-library overview. No weights, audio or inference code were executed or downloaded.

sections.title: What does the model return?
sections.text: The paper describes training paired candidate orders and aligning their distributions by candidate identity. Inference scores the supplied candidates without an order ensemble. The separate inference library exposes Choice and Noul requests, plus an experimental Score interface, and can share an audio encoding across questions. This is a closed set: your application still has to supply appropriate alternatives and a fallback when needed.

sections.title: How does DuplexJev differ?
sections.text: DuplexJev connects ASR-encoder states to a frozen language model, whereas AudioJev describes a shared full-parameter model with an option-order objective. The speech paper reports different connector configurations and timing on an eight-GPU node. These are different training and serving arrangements, not a matched speed comparison. For a useful comparison, hold audio tasks, candidate sets, batching and hardware fixed, and separate audio encoding, question scoring and end-to-end latency.

sections.title: Which results belong to the released checkpoint?
sections.text: Keep the paper’s three-seed averages separate from the model card’s single-seed, original-order results. The card also discloses audio-source overlap in part of the hidden MMAU evaluation. Neither a hidden evaluation split nor a fixed final checkpoint automatically establishes independence from all fitting or development sources.

sections.title: How should I evaluate it?
sections.text: For your own test, define a task-specific answer set and verify labels independently. Compare unchanged audio under meaning-preserving candidate permutations, align the returned probabilities by candidate identity, and measure both accuracy and order sensitivity. Assess correctness calibration separately, on held-out labeled examples. If a downstream action depends on a threshold, report the accepted fraction and error rate together. These are proposed checks, not results produced by this collection.

sections.title: What is available, and under which terms?
sections.text: The library is presented as Apache-2.0 code; the checkpoint declares the separate Qwen Research license. Review the model’s own terms before use. The release does not establish open-ended generation, visual performance or live turn-taking readiness. Follow the linked runtime documentation for hardware and deployment requirements; a documented command is not a verified deployment by this project.

zh.title: AudioJev：音频决策、顺序校准与发布范围
zh.description: 结合论文、检查点与推理库，理解候选顺序稳定性、单种子结果、数据重叠和不同许可。
zh.answer: AudioJev 是独立音频决策模型，根据波形和问题给提供的候选项打分。它的顺序校准目标处理候选顺序敏感性，不能据此认定返回概率等于实际答对的概率。
zh.scope: 依据固定 v1 摘要、公开模型卡与推理库概览整理。未下载或运行模型权重、音频或推理代码。

sections.title: 模型返回什么？
sections.text: 论文在训练中配对不同候选顺序，并按候选身份对齐分布；推理时直接对给定候选评分，不进行多顺序集成。独立推理库提供 Choice、Noul 和实验性的 Score 接口，多问题可共享一次音频编码。这仍是封闭候选集，应用需要提供合适选项，并按需明确后备选项。

sections.title: 与 DuplexJev 有什么区别？
sections.text: DuplexJev 将 ASR 编码器状态接入冻结语言模型；AudioJev 则描述带选项顺序目标的共享全参数模型。语音论文报告不同连接器配置，以及八 GPU 节点上的计时。两者训练与服务安排不同，不能直接组成公平速度比较。有效比较应固定音频任务、候选集、批处理与硬件，并区分音频编码、问题评分和端到端延迟。

sections.title: 哪些结果属于发布检查点？
sections.text: 论文三种子均值，应与模型卡的单种子、原始顺序结果分开。模型卡还披露部分隐藏 MMAU 评测的音频来源重叠。测试答案隐藏，或固定选择最终检查点，都不能自动证明其与全部拟合、开发来源独立。

sections.title: 应该怎样评测？
sections.text: 自己的测试应定义任务专属选项，并独立核对标签。保持音频不变，比较候选含义不变的顺序置换；按候选身份对齐概率，同时测量准确率与顺序敏感性。在留出标注样本上另测概率与实际正确率是否一致。如果下游动作取决于阈值，应同时报告接受比例与错误率。这些是建议检查，不是本项目跑出的结果。

sections.title: 发布了什么，适用什么许可？
sections.text: 代码库声明 Apache-2.0，而检查点声明独立的 Qwen Research 许可，使用前应阅读模型自己的条款。当前发布不能证明开放式生成、视觉性能或实时轮次切换的部署成熟度。硬件与部署要求见运行库文档；列出命令不代表本项目已经验证部署。

en.title: GraphDecisionBench: evaluating Jev on graph decisions
en.description: Understand graph structure, graph-text evidence and sequential construction as separate tasks, with versioned sources and reproduction limits.
en.answer: GraphDecisionBench evaluates different graph capabilities rather than producing one universal model ranking. Correctly recognizing an edge does not establish structural reasoning, and completing a feasible construction does not establish a high-quality solution.
en.scope: This note uses the v3 abstract and the repository’s overview and availability statements. It is not a full-paper review or benchmark reproduction.

sections.title: What are the three evaluation questions?
sections.text: The benchmark separates structural graph queries, the use of graph-plus-text information, and decisions that construct a solution over multiple steps. These comparisons diagnose different behavior. Fourteen model-interface configurations appear across the experiments; that count should not be relabeled as fourteen independent models or as identical coverage of every task.

sections.title: What must be matched before comparing scores?
sections.text: The repository treats each task and input condition separately and documents unsupported interfaces. Its structural probes use small supplied graphs and constructed answer quotas, which do not represent natural label frequencies in the source networks. When assessing a comparison, inspect the task predicate, candidate set, scoring rule and adapter before drawing a broader capability conclusion.

sections.title: A useful control for sequential decisions
sections.text: Our suggested evaluation compares a model-driven selector with the proposal rule alone, using the same candidate generator, constraints and stopping conditions. Measure feasibility and final objective quality separately. Preserve unsuccessful trajectories and their costs. If a heuristic narrows the choices, any improvement may reflect both the proposals and the selector; an identical proposal-only control helps separate their contributions.

sections.title: Which version and artifacts are covered?
sections.text: The paper was first submitted on October 5, 2026; this note uses v3 dated October 12. The repository offers code and aggregate tables but states that per-query and per-trajectory outputs are not distributed. Regenerating a chart from summaries would therefore be a different operation from checking individual predictions or rerunning the models. No such operation was performed here.

zh.title: GraphDecisionBench：怎样评估 Jev 的图决策能力
zh.description: 分别理解图结构、图文证据与序列构造任务，核对论文版本和公开材料的复现范围。
zh.answer: GraphDecisionBench 分别测量不同图能力，而非给出通用模型排名。能正确识别一条边，不等于掌握结构推理；能完成可行构造，也不等于得到高质量解。
zh.scope: 依据 v3 摘要，以及仓库概览和材料可用性声明整理；不是全文评审或基准复现。

sections.title: 三类评测分别问什么？
sections.text: 基准区分结构图查询、图文信息利用，以及多步构造解的决策。这些比较诊断不同的行为。实验覆盖十四种模型—接口配置，不能把它改称十四个独立模型，也不能据此认为每项任务的覆盖完全相同。

sections.title: 比较得分前需要对齐什么？
sections.text: 仓库按任务与输入条件分别报告，并标明不支持的接口。结构探针使用输入中给定的小图和人工构造的答案配额，不代表源网络中的自然标签频率。判断比较是否成立前，应先检查任务谓词、候选集、评分规则与适配层，再讨论更广泛的能力。

sections.title: 序列决策应该设置什么对照？
sections.text: 我们建议在相同候选生成器、约束和终止条件下，比较模型驱动的选择器与仅用提议规则的基线。分别测量可行性和最终目标质量，保留失败轨迹与成本。启发式规则缩小候选后，收益可能同时来自提议与选择器；使用相同提议规则的对照，有助于区分两者贡献。

sections.title: 覆盖哪个版本和哪些材料？
sections.text: 论文首次提交于2026年10月5日，本页使用10月12日的 v3。仓库提供代码和汇总表，但说明未分发逐查询与逐轨迹输出。因此，由汇总重绘图表、检查逐项预测与重新调用模型，是不同操作；本项目尚未执行这些操作。
